categories.name: Admission to Normal Care Inpatient Ward
categories.description: Patients are admitted to a standard non-ICU inpatient ward (Admission NC). This advances the organization's goal of reaching a documented disposition, though extended stays or repeated ward transfers can impact overall care progression.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=15 (Admission NC) under the OR-decomposed goal 5. Supported by variants such as V0008, V0625, and V0551.

categories.name: Admission to Intensive Care Ward
categories.description: Patients are admitted directly to an Intensive Care unit (Admission IC). While necessary for critical stabilization, it carries a negative contribution (-25) to minimizing time-to-treatment softgoals due to higher coordination overhead.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=16 (Admission IC) under the OR-decomposed goal 5. Supported by variants such as V0605, V0317, V0273, and V0068.

categories.name: Discharge Disposition Type A
categories.description: Patient is discharged via pathway Release A, contributing positively (+50) to avoiding post-discharge deterioration and measured against post-discharge ER return indicators.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=17 (Release A) under the OR-decomposed goal 6. Supported by variants such as V0008, V0551, V0625, and V0449.

categories.name: Discharge Disposition Type B
categories.description: Patient is discharged via pathway Release B, helping to avoid post-discharge deterioration as measured by post-discharge ER return indicators.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=18 (Release B) under the OR-decomposed goal 6. Supported by rare variant samples such as V0068 and V0145.

categories.name: Discharge Disposition Type C
categories.description: Patient is discharged via pathway Release C, representing specialized extended treatment release outcomes.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=19 (Release C) under the OR-decomposed goal 6. Supported by complex long-duration variant V0710.

categories.name: Discharge Disposition Type D
categories.description: Patient is discharged via pathway Release D, representing alternative complex clinical release flows.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=20 (Release D) under the OR-decomposed goal 6. Supported by length-high variant V0273.
